verdict.rationale: Warp here is an HR and payroll platform that ships an API, SDKs, a Homebrew CLI and agent integrations, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage analytics, or any way to opt out. Lack of evidence for an applicable capability is "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
